name: Filament
description: A tube of light of one steady width, with bright nodes running along inside it. The nodes travel toward the pointer and speed up as the hand does, so the stroke reads as something carrying current rather than something fading. A click fires a single bright packet down the whole length. The colour drifts through the spectrum as the seconds pass.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the bright core of the stroke (px)

parameters.name: Lifetime
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit (seconds)

parameters.name: Nodes
parameters.description: How many bright nodes fit along the stroke

parameters.name: Flow
parameters.description: How fast the nodes travel along the stroke, 0 to hold them still

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: How dark the stroke goes between nodes, 0 for an even tube

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Strength of the soft bloom around the core

parameters.name: Reach
parameters.description: How far the glow may paint from the path (px). Lower it to shrink the area redrawn each frame, raise it if a wide stroke's bloom looks cut off

parameters.name: Colour cycle
parameters.description: Seconds the colour takes to travel once through the whole spectrum, 0 to hold one colour

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which the stroke is not drawn (px per second), 0 to always draw

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path is smoothed before it is drawn, 0 to follow it exactly

parameters.name: Click packet
parameters.description: Brightness of the packet a click fires along the stroke, 0 to disable
